faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about using your client portal

change_contact.q: How do I change my email address or phone number?
change_contact.a: Go to Settings → Account and Safety, then choose Change Email or Change Phone Number.

two_factor.q: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
two_factor.a: Go to Settings → Account and Safety → Two-Factor Authentication. It adds an extra layer of security when you sign in.

preferences.q: Can I change the language or switch to dark mode?
preferences.a: Yes. Go to Settings → Preferences to choose English or 繁體中文, and Light, Dark or System theme. You can also switch the theme from the top bar.

suspicious_activity.q: I see activity I don't recognise. What should I do?
suspicious_activity.a: Change your password straight away and message your Relationship Manager so they can review your account.

balance_terms.q: What do Total Portfolio Value, Cash Balance and Amount in Trade mean?
balance_terms.a: Total Portfolio Value is everything in your account. Cash Balance is uninvested cash. Amount in Trade is what is currently invested in models.

hidden_balances.q: Why are my balances shown as ********?
hidden_balances.a: They are hidden for privacy. Click the eye icon next to the section title to show or hide them.

models.q: What are Subscribed Models and Recommended Models?
models.a: Subscribed Models are the investment models you currently hold. Recommended Models are models your advisory team suggests, which you can apply for with an Allotment request.

data_updates.q: How often is my portfolio data updated?
data_updates.a: Portfolio figures are refreshed regularly. If something looks out of date, message your Relationship Manager.

invest.q: How do I invest in a model?
invest.a: Raise an Allotment ticket: click the + button at the bottom right → Raise a Ticket, or use the Portfolio page. Choose the model, the amount and your funding source.

withdraw.q: How do I withdraw from a model?
withdraw.a: Raise a Redemption ticket and choose Partial Redemption or Redeem All.

redemption_time.q: How long does a redemption take?
redemption_time.a: Redemptions typically take 2–3 business days to process.

minimum.a: Yes. Each model shows its Minimum Allotment when you select it in the ticket form.

statuses.q: What do the ticket statuses mean?
statuses.a: New: received. In Progress: being processed. Resolved: completed. Declined: not approved — your Relationship Manager will explain why.

track.q: Where can I check the status of my requests?
track.a: See Recent Request Status on the Overview page, or the full, searchable Ticket History on the Portfolio page.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or change a ticket after submitting it?
cancel.a: Message your Relationship Manager as soon as possible with the ticket ID, and they will help you.

monthly.q: Where can I find my monthly statements?
monthly.a: Open Monthly Reports in the sidebar. To grab the newest one quickly, use + → Download Latest EoM Report.

legal.a: Legal agreements, fund documents and compliance references relating to your investments.

what_kyc.q: What is KYC and why do I need to renew it?
what_kyc.a: KYC (Know Your Customer) is a regulatory check that verifies your identity. It needs to be renewed every year.

upload_kyc.q: How do I upload or renew my KYC documents?
upload_kyc.a: Go to Profile → Document Verification → Upload KYC and upload a valid government ID.

kyc_time.q: How long does KYC verification take?
kyc_time.a: Usually 1–3 business days. The status shows Processing until the review is complete.

contact_rm.q: How do I contact my Relationship Manager?
contact_rm.a: Click the + button at the bottom right → Messages to chat with your advisory team.

send_files.q: Can I send documents in the chat?
send_files.a: Yes. Use the paperclip button next to the message box. Every file shared in the chat is listed under the paperclip counter at the top.

events_page.q: What appears on the Events page?
events_page.a: Market news, account notifications and updates on your requests. Use the filter to show one type at a time.

notification_settings.q: How do I choose which notifications I receive?
notification_settings.a: Go to Settings → Notifications and switch Email, Push or SMS alerts on or off.
